title: Business Analyst for Granular Reporting - Financial Supervisory Reporting
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
Financial Supervisory Reporting - Business Analyst
Background on what ING is about:
ING Hubs Philippines (ING Hubs PH) is an international part of the ING organization delivering services to many Business Units across the world for both Wholesale Banking and Retail Banking activities. Working for ING Hubs PH means working with the most diverse workforce and where no challenge is the same.
At ING our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and business. We believe that sustainable progress is driven by people with the imagination and determination to make a better future for themselves and those around them.
ING is changing what banking is. For you, that means plenty of opportunities for personal growth in a continuously evolving environment. If this is the environment you thrive in, then apply and join us in changing the future of banking!
Job Overview & Your working environment
The COO Finance (COOF) department delivers a wide range of different finance and risk-related services in the areas of change, operations, process optimization as well as data management, analytics and reporting for the Corporate Risk and Finance domains.
COOF plays a key role in supporting ING to become a data-driven organization and has a clear vision and purpose for the future:To deliver best in class data, insights and advice which empower our consumers to control, explain, predict and optimize the performance of ING.
We are looking for a committed data believer who is willing to help us lead ING towards that data-driven future. Do you understand that data helps build top notch models and ensures proper reporting to regulators? Then we are looking for you!
You'll work on solutions that drive strategic initiatives across the Finance organisation, enabling ING to reach its data driven ambition.
You will be a part of the tribe Data Foundation as aBusiness Analyst. Using your Finance and/or Risk experience you will focus on data management, data requirements, data definition & mapping, data onboarding and data modelling.
As an expert, you deliver the necessary knowledge and skills to make standard and best-in-class products/services for our data consumers. Besides that, you continuously deepen and broaden your knowledge and skills in your area of expertise within your chapter.
Your activities will be in the area of:
Collaborating with the users, suppliers & stakeholders to get the best working product
Eliciting & refining the data, regulatory & business requirements
Breaking down deliverables in clear actionable stories/tasks together with the squad
Delivering functional specifications
Data mapping, modelling and validation
Executing acceptance and other testing
Key Capabilities/Experience & Minimum Qualifications
We are looking for an pro-active and knowledgeable Senior Business Analyst with a passion for data management in a Risk & Finance context.
You are energized by working on concrete and tangible results in a complex and continuously changing environment.
You know exactly how to empathize with the needs of your users and translate this into a standard way of working and innovative products.
You will develop a clear vision on the area of expertise of the squad
You have a strong drive to grow your expertise and have the ambition to continuously improve yourself on a personal and professional level.
You are flexible, you anticipates and prepare for opportunities and obstacles
You are creative, you combines and build on the ideas of others
You easily approach others and socializes well
Proven banking & product knowledge. Finance and/or Risk experience enabling understanding of banking products and their attributes
Knowledge of, and experience with analyzing large data sets and its quality
Experience in:Data managementData requirementsData definitions (semantics)Data onboardingData modelling
Data definitions (semantics)
Hands on proficient level of experience on SQL
Your education, experience and background
You take it on and make it happen;
You continuously improve yourself and you help colleagues to be succesful;
You have an university (Bachelor’s/Master’s) degree;
You like to work in a multidisciplinary squad (agile, scrum);
You enjoy learning new skills to support the squad in becoming succesfull;
You easily adapt to new environments and embrace change;
Excellent communication skills in English. Dutch is an asset;
You actively ask for help and feedback and are not afraid to give feedback;
In short, you are always a step ahead!
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
